mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS "projectId", p.project_code AS "projectCode", p.project_name AS "projectName", p.close_time AS "closeTime", GREATEST(CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.project_nature, 'normal') = 'mandate' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(ws.ext_out, 0) END - COALESCE(ps.recv, 0), 0) AS "amount", (CURRENT_DATE - p.close_time::date) AS "days" FROM proj_project p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, SUM(COALESCE(external_output, 0)) AS ext_out FROM proj_workload WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY project_id ) ws ON ws.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'refund' THEN -COALESCE(amount, 0) ELSE COALESCE(amount, 0) END) AS recv FROM proj_payment WHERE del_flag = '0' AND pay_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_id ) ps ON ps.project_id = p.id WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.close_time IS NOT NULL AND GREATEST(CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.project_nature, 'normal') = 'mandate' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(ws.ext_out, 0) END - COALESCE(ps.recv, 0), 0) >= #{minAmount} AND (CURRENT_DATE - p.close_time::date) >= #{minDays} ORDER BY "days" DESC

SELECT p.id AS "projectId", p.project_code AS "projectCode", p.project_name AS "projectName", p.assign_date AS "assignDate", p.duration_require AS "durationRequire" FROM proj_project p WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.data_source = 'manual' AND p.close_time IS NULL AND p.assign_date IS NOT NULL AND p.duration_require IS NOT NULL AND p.duration_require > 0

SELECT p.id AS "projectId", p.project_code AS "projectCode", p.project_name AS "projectName", p.create_time AS "createTime" FROM proj_project p WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.data_source = 'manual' AND p.contract_id IS NULL AND p.create_time IS NOT NULL AND p.create_time::date < CURRENT_DATE
mapper.insert: insert into proj_notify ( notify_type, biz_type, biz_id, project_id, project_code, project_name, title, content, receiver_id, receiver_role_id, route_path, route_query, priority, status, create_by, create_time ) values ( 'alert', #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{projectId}, #{projectCode}, #{projectName}, #{title}, #{content}, #{receiverId}, #{receiverRoleId}, #{routePath}, #{routeQuery}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{createBy}, now() ) on conflict (biz_type, biz_id, receiver_id) where del_flag = '0' do update set title = excluded.title, content = excluded.content, project_name = excluded.project_name, priority = excluded.priority, route_query = excluded.route_query, update_time = now(), status = case when proj_notify.status = 'done' then 'unread' else proj_notify.status end, done_time = case when proj_notify.status = 'done' then null else proj_notify.done_time end
